portal_description:
The Pacemaker cluster resource manager is a collection of technologies working together to maintain data integrity and application availability in the event of failures.

Bug fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Running crm_node from an OCF resource agent's metadata action will hang until the timeout is reached because metadata actions block the controller (BZ#2128037)
